ko.B: 예수에 대한 소식이 곧바로 갈릴리 일대 곳곳으로 퍼져 나갔다.
ko.R: 곧 갈릴리 온 지역 사람들이 예수에 대해 듣게 되었다.

es.L: Y salió enseguida la noticia acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por todas partes, a toda la región de alrededor de Galilea.
es.B: Muy pronto la noticia acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se extendió por todas partes, por toda la comarca de Galilea.
es.R: Muy pronto, la gente de toda la región de Galilea oyó hablar de Jesús.

fr.L: Et la nouvelle à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sujet se répandit aussitôt partout, dans toute la région environnante de la Galilée.
fr.B: On parla de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussitôt dans toutes les directions, à travers toute la région de Galilée.
fr.R: Très vite, dans toute la région de Galilée, les gens ont entendu parler de Jésus.

decisions.choice: the surrounding region of Galilee: the whole region of Galilee round about
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely means all of Galilee around Capernaum, though it could include lands beyond it.

decisions.choice: report: what people heard and told about him
decisions.reason: The word means something heard, news passed on by word of mouth.

decisions.choice: "갈릴리 일대" (L, B); "갈릴리 온 지역" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as the whole region of Galilee round about; "갈릴리 주변" would suggest the lands around Galilee, outside it.

source.text: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately out of the synagogue having gone out they came into the house of Simon and Andrew with James and John.

en.L: And immediately, going out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
en.B: They left the synagogue and went straight to the house where Simon and Andrew lived, and James and John came with them.
en.R: Right after that, they left the synagogue and went to Simon and Andrew's house. James and John went with them.

vi.L: Và lập tức, ra khỏi nhà hội, họ đến nhà của Si-môn và Anh-rê, cùng với Gia-cơ và Giăng.
vi.B: Vừa ra khỏi nhà hội, họ đi thẳng đến nhà của Si-môn và Anh-rê, có Gia-cơ và Giăng cùng đi.
vi.R: Ngay sau đó, họ rời nhà hội và đi đến nhà của Si-môn và Anh-rê. Gia-cơ và Giăng cũng đi với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 그들은 회당에서 나와서, 야고보와 요한과 함께 시몬과 안드레의 집으로 들어갔다.
ko.B: 그들은 회당에서 나오자 곧바로 시몬과 안드레가 사는 집으로 갔다. 야고보와 요한도 함께 갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 회당에서 나와 바로 시몬과 안드레의 집으로 갔다. 야고보와 요한도 함께 갔다.

es.L: Y enseguida, saliendo de la sinagoga, fueron a la casa de Simón y Andrés, con Santiago y Juan.
es.B: En cuanto salieron de la sinagoga, fueron a la casa de Simón y Andrés, y Santiago y Juan fueron con ellos.
es.R: Enseguida salieron de la sinagoga y fueron a la casa de Simón y Andrés. Santiago y Juan fueron con ellos.

fr.L: Et aussitôt, étant sortis de la synagogue, ils vinrent dans la maison de Simon et d’André, avec Jacques et Jean.
fr.B: En sortant de la synagogue, ils allèrent tout droit à la maison de Simon et d’André, avec Jacques et Jean.
fr.R: Juste après, ils sont sortis de la synagogue et ils sont allés chez Simon et André. Jacques et Jean étaient avec eux.

decisions.choice: they went out and came: the plural, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have the singular, with Jesus as the subject. With the plural, "they" are Jesus and the four disciples. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the house of Simon and Andrew: the brothers' home in Capernaum
alternatives: a house they rented for Jesus
decisions.reason: John 1:44 says the brothers came from Bethsaida; by now they lived in Capernaum, where Simon's family was.

source.text: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα, καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: And the mother-in-law of Simon was lying down fevering, and immediately they speak to him about her.

en.L: Now Simon's mother-in-law was lying down sick with a fever, and immediately they tell {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about her.
en.B: Simon's mother-in-law lay ill with a fever, and they lost no time in telling {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about her.
en.R: Simon's mother-in-law was lying in bed with a fever. Right away they told Jesus that she was sick.

vi.L: Và mẹ vợ của Si-môn đang nằm, bị sốt, và lập tức họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về bà.
vi.B: Mẹ vợ của Si-môn đang nằm vì bị sốt, nên họ liền thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về bà.
vi.R: Mẹ vợ của Si-môn đang bị sốt, nằm trên giường. Họ liền cho Đức Giê-xu biết bà bị bệnh.

ko.L: 그런데 시몬의 장모가 열병으로 누워 있었다. 그리고 곧 그들이 그분께 그 여자에 관하여 말씀드린다.
ko.B: 시몬의 장모가 열병으로 앓아누워 있었는데, 사람들은 지체 없이 예수께 그 사실을 알려 드렸다.
ko.R: 시몬의 장모는 열이 나서 자리에 누워 있었다. 그들은 바로 예수께 장모가 아프다고 말씀드렸다.

es.L: Y la suegra de Simón estaba acostada con fiebre, y enseguida {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hablan de ella.
es.B: La suegra de Simón estaba en cama con fiebre, y enseguida {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hablaron de ella.
es.R: La suegra de Simón estaba acostada con fiebre. Enseguida avisaron a Jesús de que estaba enferma.

fr.L: Or la belle-mère de Simon était couchée, ayant de la fièvre, et aussitôt ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parlent d’elle.
fr.B: La belle-mère de Simon était au lit avec de la fièvre, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parlèrent d’elle sans tarder.
fr.R: La belle-mère de Simon était au lit, elle avait de la fièvre. Tout de suite, ils ont dit à Jésus qu’elle était malade.

decisions.choice: Simon's mother-in-law: Simon was married
decisions.reason: Paul says that Peter took his wife with him on his travels (1 Corinthians 9:5).

decisions.choice: lying down with a fever: too ill to get up
decisions.reason: Fever could be a sign of serious illness, and she was in bed with it.

decisions.choice: they speak: the present tense of storytelling
decisions.reason: Mark tells this in the present tense to make it vivid.

decisions.choice: "장모"; "말씀드리다", "알려 드리다" for telling Jesus
decisions.reason: Korean names a man's mother-in-law "장모" (his wife's mother); "시어머니" is a woman's mother-in-law. Speaking to Jesus is expressed with the humble verbs "말씀드리다" and "-어 드리다" in the narrative, as the honorific requires.

source.text: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός· καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And having come to [her] he raised her having taken hold of the hand; and left her the fever, and she was serving them.

en.L: And coming to [her], {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised her up, taking hold of [her] hand; and the fever left her, and she began serving them.
en.B: He came over, took hold of her hand, and lifted her up. Her fever was gone, and she started to look after them.
en.R: Jesus went to her. He took her hand and helped her get up. The fever went away, and she began to serve them food.

vi.L: Và đến gần, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đỡ bà dậy, nắm lấy tay [bà]; và cơn sốt rời khỏi bà, và bà phục vụ họ.
vi.B: Ngài đến bên bà, nắm tay bà và đỡ bà dậy. Cơn sốt dứt, và bà bắt đầu tiếp đãi họ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đến bên bà. Ngài nắm tay bà và giúp bà ngồi dậy. Cơn sốt dứt hẳn, và bà bắt đầu dọn thức ăn cho họ.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 다가가셔서 손을 잡고 그 여자를 일으키셨다. 그러자 열이 그 여자에게서 떠났고, 그 여자는 그들을 섬기기 시작했다.
ko.B: 예수께서 다가가셔서 그 여자의 손을 잡아 일으키셨다. 그러자 열이 내렸고, 그 여자는 그들을 대접하기 시작했다.
ko.R: 예수께서 장모에게 가셨다. 예수께서 그 손을 잡고 일으켜 주셨다. 그러자 열이 내렸다. 장모는 그들에게 음식을 차려 주었다.

es.L: Y acercándose, la levantó tomándola de la mano; y la fiebre la dejó, y ella les servía.
es.B: Él se acercó, la tomó de la mano y la levantó. Se le quitó la fiebre, y se puso a atenderlos.
es.R: Jesús se acercó a ella. La tomó de la mano y la ayudó a levantarse. La fiebre se le fue, y ella comenzó a servirles comida.

fr.L: Et s’étant approché, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la releva, l’ayant prise par la main ; et la fièvre la quitta, et elle les servait.
fr.B: Il s’approcha, la prit par la main et la fit se lever. La fièvre la quitta, et elle se mit à les servir.
fr.R: Jésus s’est approché d’elle. Il lui a pris la main et l’a aidée à se lever. La fièvre est partie, et elle s’est mise à leur servir à manger.

decisions.choice: raised her up: helped her to stand
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for raising the dead (5:41; 16:6), but here it means getting her up from her bed.

decisions.choice: serving them: looking after them as her guests
decisions.reason: She took up the work of a host, which shows that the cure was complete. The same verb is used of the angels in 1:13 and of Jesus himself in 10:45.

decisions.choice: she began serving: the imperfect describes what she went on doing
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous: she got up and set about caring for them.

decisions.choice: serve them food
decisions.reason: Readable says what serving guests most likely meant here: giving them a meal.

decisions.choice: "섬기다" (L); "대접하다" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "섬기다", the same word as for the angels in 1:13, as the Greek repeats its verb; Balanced uses "대접하다" (look after guests), the sense here (meaning decision).

source.text: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης, ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος, ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους·

records.literal_gloss: Evening and having come, when set the sun, they were bringing to him all the [ones] badly having and the [ones] being demon-possessed.

en.L: Now when evening had come, when the sun set, they were bringing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all who were sick and those who were demon-possessed.
en.B: When evening came and the sun had set, people began bringing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} everyone who was ill or controlled by demons.
en.R: That evening, after the sun went down, people brought all the sick to Jesus, and all who had demons in them.

vi.L: Khi chiều đến, lúc mặt trời đã lặn, người ta đem đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tất cả những người đau ốm và những người bị quỷ ám.
vi.B: Chiều hôm ấy, khi mặt trời đã lặn, người ta bắt đầu đem đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mọi người đau ốm và những người bị quỷ ám.
vi.R: Chiều hôm đó, sau khi mặt trời lặn, người ta đem tất cả những người bệnh và những người bị quỷ nhập đến với Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 저녁이 되어 해가 졌을 때, 사람들이 모든 앓는 사람들과 귀신 들린 사람들을 그분께로 데려오고 있었다.
ko.B: 저녁이 되어 해가 지자, 사람들이 아픈 사람들과 귀신 들린 사람들을 모두 예수께 데려오기 시작했다.
ko.R: 그날 저녁 해가 진 뒤에, 사람들이 아픈 사람들을 모두 예수께 데려왔다. 귀신 들린 사람들도 데려왔다.

es.L: Y llegada la tarde, cuando se puso el sol, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traían a todos los que estaban enfermos y a los endemoniados.
es.B: Al anochecer, cuando ya se había puesto el sol, la gente {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llevaba a todos los enfermos y a los que estaban dominados por demonios.
es.R: Esa tarde, después de que se puso el sol, la gente llevó a Jesús a todos los enfermos y a todos los que tenían demonios.

fr.L: Le soir venu, quand le soleil se fut couché, ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amenaient tous ceux qui étaient malades et ceux qui étaient possédés par des démons.
fr.B: Le soir, après le coucher du soleil, on se mit à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amener tous les malades et tous ceux qui étaient possédés par des démons.
fr.R: Ce soir-là, après le coucher du soleil, les gens ont amené à Jésus tous les malades, et tous ceux qui avaient des démons en eux.

decisions.choice: when the sun set: the Sabbath ended at sunset
decisions.reason: The Sabbath of 1:21 ended at sunset. Then people could carry the sick without breaking the Sabbath rest.

decisions.choice: demon-possessed: under the control of demons
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the sick and the demon-possessed apart (1:34): illness is healed, demons are cast out.

decisions.choice: they were bringing: one after another
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous: people kept bringing the sick.

decisions.choice: "bị quỷ ám" (L, B); "bị quỷ nhập" (R)
decisions.reason: "quỷ" is the word for demon, as in John; "ám" (haunt, possess) is the usual verb, and Readable's "nhập" (enter) is plainer.

decisions.choice: "귀신 들린 사람" at every level; "귀신" for demon, through Mark
decisions.reason: "귀신" is the everyday Korean word for an evil spirit that possesses a person, as in John 10:20-21 in Korean; "악령" sounds technical.

decisions.choice: endemoniados (L); dominados por demonios (B); que tenían demonios (R)
decisions.reason: "Endemoniado" is the Spanish word for the Greek participle; Balanced and Readable say in plain words what it means (meaning decision m2), and use "demonio" for the noun, as in John 10:20.

decisions.choice: possédés par des démons (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Démoniaque" in French today is mostly an adjective for something wicked; "possédés par des démons" says plainly what the Greek word means (meaning decision m2).

source.text: καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν.

records.literal_gloss: And was all the city gathered together at the door.

en.L: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.
en.B: The entire town had crowded together outside the door.
en.R: Almost everyone in the town crowded around the door of the house.

vi.L: Và cả thành đã tụ họp lại trước cửa.
vi.B: Cả thị trấn kéo đến tụ tập trước cửa.
vi.R: Hầu như mọi người trong thị trấn đều kéo đến, đứng chen chúc trước cửa nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 온 고을이 문 앞에 모여 있었다.
ko.B: 온 동네 사람들이 그 집 문 앞에 몰려들었다.
ko.R: 마을 사람들이 거의 다 그 집 문 앞으로 몰려왔다.

es.L: Y toda la ciudad estaba reunida a la puerta.
es.B: Todo el pueblo se había agolpado a la puerta.
es.R: Casi toda la gente del pueblo se juntó frente a la puerta de la casa.

fr.L: Et la ville entière était rassemblée à la porte.
fr.B: Toute la ville s’était rassemblée devant la porte.
fr.R: Presque tous les habitants de la ville se pressaient devant la porte de la maison.

decisions.choice: the whole city: a great crowd from the town
decisions.reason: "Whole" stresses how many came, as in 1:5.

decisions.choice: city: a town
decisions.reason: The word is used for any town with walls or a council. Capernaum was a lakeside town.

decisions.choice: town (B, R); city (L)
decisions.reason: Capernaum was small, so Balanced and Readable say "town". Readable says "almost everyone" to show the exaggeration.
Capernaum was a town (meaning decision); "도시" (city) would make it sound large and "성" (walled city) is old-fashioned. "고을" is the word used for a town in John 1:44 in Korean.

decisions.choice: la ville (every level)
decisions.reason: French "ville" is used of a town of any size, so it can stand at every level where English moves from "city" to "town" (meaning decision m2).

source.text: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις, καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν, καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And he healed many badly having various diseases and demons many he cast out, and not he was allowing to speak the demons, because they knew him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed many who were sick with various diseases, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cast out many demons; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was not allowing the demons to speak, because they knew {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: He cured many people who had diseases of every kind, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} threw out many demons. He did not permit the demons to say anything, since they knew {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus healed many people who had all kinds of sicknesses. He forced many demons to leave people. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not let the demons talk, because they knew who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành nhiều người đau ốm vì đủ thứ bệnh, và đuổi nhiều quỷ; và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho các quỷ nói, vì chúng biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài chữa lành nhiều người mắc đủ loại bệnh tật, và đuổi nhiều quỷ ra. Ngài không cho các quỷ nói gì, vì chúng biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu chữa lành nhiều người mắc đủ thứ bệnh. Ngài buộc nhiều quỷ phải ra khỏi người ta. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho các quỷ nói, vì chúng biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 여러 가지 병으로 앓는 많은 사람들을 고치시고, 많은 귀신들을 쫓아내셨다. 그리고 귀신들이 말하는 것을 허락하지 않으셨다. 그들이 그분을 알았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 온갖 병에 걸린 많은 사람을 고쳐 주시고, 많은 귀신을 쫓아내셨다. 그러나 귀신들이 아무 말도 하지 못하게 하셨다. 귀신들은 그분을 알고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 온갖 병을 앓는 많은 사람을 고쳐 주셨다. 또 많은 귀신을 사람들에게서 쫓아내셨다. 그러나 귀신들이 말하지 못하게 하셨다. 귀신들은 예수께서 누구신지 알고 있었기 때문이다.

es.L: Y sanó a muchos que estaban enfermos de diversas enfermedades, y expulsó muchos demonios, y no dejaba hablar a los demonios, porque {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocían.
es.B: Curó a muchos que padecían enfermedades de toda clase y expulsó a muchos demonios. Pero no dejaba que los demonios dijeran nada, porque {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocían.
es.R: Jesús sanó a mucha gente que tenía toda clase de enfermedades. Obligó a muchos demonios a salir de la gente. Pero no dejaba hablar a los demonios, porque sabían quién era.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} guérit beaucoup de malades atteints de diverses maladies, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} chassa beaucoup de démons ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissait pas les démons parler, parce qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissaient.
fr.B: Il guérit beaucoup de gens atteints de toutes sortes de maladies, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} chassa beaucoup de démons. Il ne permettait pas aux démons de parler, puisqu’ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissaient.
fr.R: Jésus a guéri beaucoup de gens qui avaient toutes sortes de maladies. Il a obligé beaucoup de démons à quitter les gens. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissait pas les démons parler, parce qu’ils savaient qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était.

decisions.choice: many: a great number, not a hint that some were left unhealed
decisions.reason: In Hebrew and Greek, "many" can stand for a large whole, as in 10:45. Matthew 8:16 says he healed all who were sick.

decisions.choice: he would not let the demons speak: he kept them from making him known
alternatives: he did not want to hear lies
decisions.reason: The demons knew who he was (1:24). Jesus silences them, as he does in 3:11-12, and makes himself known in his own way and time.

decisions.choice: they knew him, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts add "to be the Christ", likely from Luke 4:41. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: cast out: drove out with force
decisions.reason: This is the verb of 1:12, used for expelling demons by command.

decisions.choice: threw out (B); forced ... to leave (R)
decisions.reason: "Cast out" is old church language. Balanced uses an everyday verb with the same force.

decisions.choice: "쫓아내다" at every level, through Mark
decisions.reason: "귀신을 쫓아내다" is the natural Korean phrase and carries the force the meaning decision describes, so one word serves at every level where the English varies ("cast out", "threw out", "forced to leave").

decisions.choice: expulsar
decisions.reason: The Spanish verb for driving out with force (meaning decision m4); it is used for demons throughout Mark. Readable says "obligar a salir", as the English says "forced to leave".

decisions.choice: chasser (L, B) for casting out demons
decisions.reason: "Chasser" is the ordinary French verb for driving out by force (meaning decision m4); Readable says "obliger à quitter", as the English Readable says "forced ... to leave".

source.text: Καὶ πρωῒ ἔννυχα λίαν ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο.

records.literal_gloss: And early in night very having risen he went out and went away into a solitary place, and there he was praying.

en.L: And very early, while still night, rising up, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went out and went away into a deserted place, and there {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was praying.
en.B: Long before daylight, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} got up and went out. He went off to a lonely place and spent time there in prayer.
en.R: Very early the next morning, before it got light, Jesus got up and left the house. He went to a place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could be alone, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} prayed there.

vi.L: Và sáng sớm, lúc trời còn rất tối, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thức dậy, đi ra và đến một nơi hoang vắng, và ở đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầu nguyện.
vi.B: Sáng sớm, lúc trời còn tối, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thức dậy và ra đi. Ngài đến một nơi hoang vắng và cầu nguyện ở đó.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau, khi trời còn chưa sáng, Đức Giê-xu thức dậy và rời khỏi nhà. Ngài đi đến một nơi có thể ở một mình, và cầu nguyện tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 아주 이른 새벽, 아직 밤일 때에 그분은 일어나 나가셔서 외딴곳으로 가셨고, 거기에서 기도하고 계셨다.
ko.B: 날이 밝기 훨씬 전에 예수께서 일어나 밖으로 나가셨다. 그리고 외딴곳으로 가셔서 그곳에서 기도하셨다.
ko.R: 다음 날 아주 이른 새벽, 아직 어두울 때 예수께서 일어나 집을 나서셨다. 혼자 있을 수 있는 조용한 곳으로 가셔서 그곳에서 기도하셨다.

es.L: Y muy de madrugada, siendo aún de noche, levantándose, salió y se fue a un lugar desierto, y allí oraba.
es.B: Mucho antes del amanecer, se levantó y salió. Se fue a un lugar solitario y allí estuvo orando.
es.R: Al día siguiente, muy temprano, antes de que amaneciera, Jesús se levantó y salió de la casa. Se fue a un lugar donde pudiera estar solo, y allí oró.

fr.L: Et de grand matin, alors qu’il faisait encore tout à fait nuit, s’étant levé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sortit et s’en alla dans un lieu désert, et là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} priait.
fr.B: Bien avant le jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se leva et sortit. Il s’en alla dans un lieu désert, et là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} priait.
fr.R: Le lendemain, très tôt, quand il faisait encore nuit, Jésus s’est levé et a quitté la maison. Il est allé dans un endroit où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pouvait être seul, et là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prié.

decisions.choice: very early, while still night: before dawn
decisions.reason: The three words together mean the last part of the night, before first light.

decisions.choice: a deserted place: the word for the wilderness of 1:3-13
decisions.reason: The place is "wilderness-like", empty of people. Jesus withdraws there to pray, as he will again (6:46; 14:32-39).

decisions.choice: he was praying: he spent time in prayer
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous; he was still praying when they found him (1:37).

decisions.choice: left the house
decisions.reason: Readable says where he went out from, Simon's house (1:29).

decisions.choice: "nơi hoang vắng" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that Mark uses his word for the wilderness; "hoang" keeps the echo of "đồng hoang" (1:3-13). Also in 1:45.

decisions.choice: "외딴곳" (L, B); "혼자 있을 수 있는 조용한 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek adjective is the word for the wilderness of 1:3-13 (meaning decision), but this is a lonely spot near Capernaum; "광야" would send Jesus into the desert. Korean cannot keep the link, which the meaning decision records.

decisions.choice: lugar desierto (L); lugar solitario (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "desierto" so the link with the wilderness of 1:3-13 can be seen (meaning decision m2); Balanced says what kind of place it was.

decisions.choice: un lieu désert (L, B)
decisions.reason: French keeps the word "désert" of 1:3-13 (see 1:3), so the link the meaning decision points out stays visible at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what the place was for.

source.text: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε.

records.literal_gloss: And hunted down him Simon and those with him, \v 37 and found him and they say to him, All are seeking you.

en.L: And Simon and those with him searched hard for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 37 and they found {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and say to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Everyone is looking for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: Simon and the others with him tracked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} down. \v 37 Finding {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, they said, "Everybody is out looking for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"
en.R: Simon and his friends went to look for Jesus. \v 37 They found {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "All the people are looking for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"

vi.L: Và Si-môn cùng những người ở với ông đuổi theo tìm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 37 và họ tìm gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Mọi người đang tìm Thầy."
vi.B: Si-môn và những người đi với ông lùng tìm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 37 Gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ thưa: "Ai cũng đang đi tìm Thầy!"
vi.R: Si-môn và các bạn của ông đi tìm Đức Giê-xu. \v 37 Khi gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ nói: "Mọi người đều đang tìm Thầy đó!"

ko.L: 그리고 시몬과 그와 함께 있던 이들이 그분을 뒤쫓아 찾아다녔다. \v 37 그리고 그분을 찾아내고 그분께 말씀드린다. "모두가 선생님을 찾고 있습니다."
ko.B: 시몬과 그 일행이 예수를 찾아 나섰다. \v 37 그들은 예수를 찾아내고 말씀드렸다. "모든 사람이 선생님을 찾고 있습니다!"
ko.R: 시몬과 그 친구들이 예수를 찾으러 다녔다. \v 37 그들은 예수를 찾아서 말씀드렸다. "사람들이 모두 선생님을 찾고 있습니다!"

es.L: Y Simón y los que [estaban] con él {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} buscaron afanosamente, \v 37 y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontraron y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dicen: «Todos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan».
es.B: Simón y los que estaban con él salieron en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} busca. \v 37 Cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontraron, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «¡Todo el mundo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} está buscando!».
es.R: Simón y sus amigos fueron a buscar a Jesús. \v 37 Cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} encontraron, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «¡Toda la gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} está buscando!».

fr.L: Et Simon et ceux qui étaient avec lui partirent à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} poursuite, \v 37 et ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouvèrent et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disent : « Tous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent. »
fr.B: Simon et ses compagnons partirent à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} recherche. \v 37 Quand ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}eurent trouvé, ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Tout le monde {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherche ! »
fr.R: Simon et ses amis sont partis chercher Jésus. \v 37 Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont trouvé et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Tout le monde {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherche ! »

decisions.choice: searched hard for: hunted him down
decisions.reason: The verb means to pursue closely. They are eager to bring him back to the crowds.

decisions.choice: those with him: Andrew, James and John
decisions.reason: These are the others who were with Simon in 1:29.

decisions.choice: they say: the present tense of storytelling
decisions.reason: Mark tells this in the present tense to make it vivid.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "you" when the disciples speak to Jesus, with no setting span
decisions.reason: As in John 1:38: disciples address Jesus with the noun "Thầy" (Teacher), always capitalised, so the deity_pronoun setting does not apply.

decisions.choice: the disciples speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 ("있습니다"), with "선생님" for "you", through Mark
decisions.reason: As the style guide and John 1:49 in Korean: people address Jesus formally, and since "당신" would be rude to a respected teacher, a title stands in for the pronoun.

source.text: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις, ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖ κηρύξω, εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐξῆλθον.

records.literal_gloss: And he says to them, Let us go elsewhere into the neighboring towns, so that also there I may proclaim; for this for I came out.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to them, "Let us go elsewhere, into the neighboring towns, so that I may proclaim there also; for this is why I came out."
en.B: He replied, "Let us move on to the market towns nearby, so that I can proclaim the message there as well. This is what I came out to do."
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Let us go to the other towns near here, so that I can tell people the good news there too. That is why I came."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Chúng ta hãy đi nơi khác, vào các thị trấn lân cận, để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng rao giảng ở đó, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ra đi vì điều này."
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Chúng ta hãy đi đến các thị trấn lân cận, để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng rao giảng ở đó nữa. Chính vì việc này mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ra đi."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Chúng ta hãy đi đến những thị trấn khác ở gần đây, để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng báo Tin Lành cho người ta ở đó. Đó là lý do {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đến."

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하신다. "다른 곳으로, 가까운 고을들로 가자. 거기서도 내가 선포하려는 것이다. 이것을 위하여 내가 나왔기 때문이다."
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "가까운 다른 고을들로 가자. 거기서도 내가 말씀을 선포해야 한다. 나는 이 일을 하러 나왔다."
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "가까이 있는 다른 마을들로 가자. 거기서도 사람들에게 기쁜 소식을 전해야 한다. 내가 온 것은 바로 그 일 때문이다."

es.L: Y les dice: «Vamos a otra parte, a los pueblos vecinos, para que proclame también allí; porque para esto he salido».
es.B: Él les respondió: «Vamos a los pueblos cercanos, para que también allí anuncie el mensaje. Para eso he salido».
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Vamos a los otros pueblos que hay por aquí cerca, para anunciar también allí la buena noticia a la gente. Para eso vine».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Allons ailleurs, dans les bourgades voisines, afin que là aussi je prêche, car c’est pour cela que je suis sorti. »
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Allons ailleurs, dans les bourgs voisins, pour que j’y annonce aussi le message. C’est pour cela que je suis sorti. »
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Allons dans les autres villages près d’ici, pour que là aussi je dise aux gens la bonne nouvelle. C’est pour cela que je suis venu. »

decisions.choice: towns: market towns, larger than villages
decisions.reason: The word joins village and city: country towns with their own markets.

decisions.choice: I came out: from Capernaum, or from God who sent him
alternatives: I came out of the house this morning
decisions.reason: The words most likely mean that this is why he left the town, to preach elsewhere. Luke 4:43 says "I was sent", and the words may also hint at his mission from God.

decisions.choice: so that I may proclaim: his purpose is to preach, not only to heal
alternatives: so that I can heal there
decisions.reason: He leaves the crowd that came for healing and goes to proclaim the kingdom (1:14-15).

decisions.choice: tell people the good news
decisions.reason: Readable says what Jesus proclaimed, the good news of 1:14-15.

decisions.choice: "나왔다" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether Jesus came out from Capernaum or came out from God; "나왔다" (came out) can be read both ways, as the Greek can. Readable says simply "온 것" (came), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: he salido (L, B); vine (R)
decisions.reason: Like the Greek, "salir" leaves open whether Jesus means leaving Capernaum or coming from God (meaning decision m2); Readable's "vine" also keeps both.

decisions.choice: proclamer with an object (1:4, 1:7, 1:14, 1:45); prêcher without one (1:38-39, L); annoncer le message (1:38, B)
decisions.reason: French "proclamer" needs an object; where the Greek verb has none, Literal says "prêcher", the French verb that stands alone, and Balanced supplies "le message", as the English Balanced does.

source.text: καὶ ἦλθεν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλων.

records.literal_gloss: And he came proclaiming into the synagogues of them into all the Galilee and the demons casting out.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went, proclaiming in their synagogues throughout all Galilee and casting out the demons.
en.B: He went into their synagogues all over Galilee, where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} proclaimed the message and threw out demons.
en.R: Jesus went all over Galilee. He preached in their synagogues and forced demons to leave people.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đi, rao giảng trong các nhà hội của họ khắp cả Ga-li-lê, và đuổi các quỷ.
vi.B: Ngài đi vào các nhà hội của họ khắp miền Ga-li-lê, rao giảng và đuổi quỷ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đi khắp miền Ga-li-lê. Ngài giảng dạy trong các nhà hội của họ và buộc các quỷ ra khỏi người ta.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 온 갈릴리에 있는 그들의 회당들로 다니시며 선포하시고 귀신들을 쫓아내셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 갈릴리 전역에 있는 그들의 회당에 들어가셔서 말씀을 선포하시고 귀신들을 쫓아내셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 갈릴리 곳곳을 다니셨다. 회당에서 말씀을 전하시고, 사람들에게서 귀신들을 쫓아내셨다.

es.L: Y fue proclamando en sus sinagogas por toda Galilea y expulsando los demonios.
es.B: Así recorrió toda Galilea: entraba en sus sinagogas, anunciaba el mensaje y expulsaba demonios.
es.R: Jesús recorrió toda la región de Galilea. Predicaba en las sinagogas de aquella gente y obligaba a los demonios a salir de las personas.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} alla, prêchant dans leurs synagogues, dans toute la Galilée, et chassant les démons.
fr.B: Il parcourut toute la Galilée ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prêchait dans leurs synagogues et chassait les démons.
fr.R: Jésus est allé partout en Galilée. Il a prêché dans leurs synagogues et a obligé les démons à quitter les gens.

decisions.choice: he came, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "he was preaching". The meaning is much the same. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: a summary of his work: preaching and casting out demons
decisions.reason: Mark sums up a time of travel in a sentence; preaching and casting out demons go together, as in 3:14-15.

decisions.choice: threw out (B); forced ... to leave (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 1:34.

source.text: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λεπρὸς παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ γονυπετῶν λέγων αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.

records.literal_gloss: And comes to him a leper begging him and kneeling and saying to him, If you are willing you are able me to cleanse.

en.L: And a leper comes to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, begging {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and kneeling, and saying to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are willing, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are able to cleanse me."
en.B: A man with a serious skin disease came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Falling on his knees, he pleaded with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are willing, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have the power to make me clean."
en.R: A man with leprosy, a bad skin disease, came to Jesus. He got down on his knees and begged {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want to, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} can heal me and make me clean!"

vi.L: Và một người phung đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, quỳ xuống và nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Nếu Thầy muốn, Thầy có thể làm cho tôi được sạch."
vi.B: Một người mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Anh quỳ xuống van nài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Nếu Thầy muốn, Thầy có quyền làm cho tôi được sạch."
vi.R: Có một người bị bệnh phong, một bệnh ngoài da rất nặng, đến gặp Đức Giê-xu. Anh quỳ xuống và nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Nếu Thầy muốn, Thầy có thể chữa cho tôi lành bệnh và được sạch!"

ko.L: 그리고 나병 환자 한 사람이 그분께 와서 간청하며 무릎을 꿇고 그분께 말씀드린다. "선생님께서 원하시면, 선생님께서는 저를 깨끗하게 하실 수 있습니다."
ko.B: 악성 피부병에 걸린 사람 하나가 예수께 왔다. 그는 무릎을 꿇고 간절히 빌었다. "선생님께서 원하시기만 하면 저를 깨끗하게 하실 수 있습니다."
ko.R: 나병, 곧 심한 피부병을 앓는 사람이 예수께 왔다. 그는 무릎을 꿇고 빌었다. "선생님께서 원하시면 제 병을 고쳐서 저를 깨끗하게 해 주실 수 있습니다!"

es.L: Y viene hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} un leproso, que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suplica de rodillas y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dice: «Si quieres, puedes limpiarme».
es.B: Un hombre con una grave enfermedad de la piel se acercó a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Se puso de rodillas y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suplicó: «Si quieres, tienes poder para limpiarme».
es.R: Un hombre que tenía lepra, una enfermedad grave de la piel, se acercó a Jesús. Se arrodilló y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogó: «¡Si quieres, puedes sanarme y dejarme limpio!».

fr.L: Et un lépreux vient vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suppliant et tombant à genoux, et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disant : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le veux, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} peux me purifier. »
fr.B: Un homme atteint d’une grave maladie de peau vint à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il tomba à genoux et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplia : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le veux, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as le pouvoir de me rendre pur. »
fr.R: Un homme qui avait la lèpre, une grave maladie de la peau, est venu voir Jésus. Il s’est mis à genoux et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a supplié : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le veux, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} peux me guérir et me rendre pur ! »

decisions.choice: leper: a person with a skin disease that made him unclean
decisions.reason: The word covered many skin diseases, which the law of Leviticus 13 tells the priests to judge. Not all were what is now called leprosy.

decisions.choice: unclean: he had to live apart from others
decisions.reason: A person with such a disease had to live outside the town and warn others away (Leviticus 13:45-46). Touching him made a person unclean.

decisions.choice: cleanse: heal the disease and make him clean before God's law
decisions.reason: Being cleansed meant the disease was gone and he could rejoin the community and its worship.

decisions.choice: and kneeling, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts do not have these words. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: a man with a serious skin disease (B); a man with leprosy, a bad skin disease (R)
decisions.reason: "Leper" now sounds like a label for an outcast, and leprosy today names one disease. Balanced names the condition more broadly; Readable keeps the familiar word and explains it.

decisions.choice: "người phung" (L); "người mắc bệnh ngoài da nặng" (B); "bệnh phong, một bệnh ngoài da rất nặng" (R)
alternatives: "người bị bệnh phong" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word covered several serious skin diseases, not only what is now called leprosy. Literal keeps the traditional word, Balanced describes the disease as the English does, and Readable names it and explains it. "cùi" is felt as harsh.

decisions.choice: the man calls Jesus "Thầy" and himself "tôi"; Jesus calls him "anh" (1:44)
decisions.reason: A man who kneels and pleads honours Jesus as a teacher, as the style guide allows for others who respect him; Jesus speaks to him as to an adult. Not marked with a setting span.

decisions.choice: "나병 환자" (L); "악성 피부병에 걸린 사람" (B); "나병, 곧 심한 피부병을 앓는 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word covered several serious skin diseases that made a person unclean (meaning decision), not only Hansen's disease, so "한센병" would name a modern diagnosis the text does not make. "문둥병" is now offensive. Literal keeps the traditional "나병"; Balanced and Readable describe the disease, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "선생님께서" twice for the repeated "you" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean addresses a respected person with a title rather than "당신" (as John 1:49 in Korean); Literal repeats it as the Greek repeats "you".

decisions.choice: limpiar (L, B); sanar y dejar limpio (R)
decisions.reason: The man asks to be made clean under God's law as well as healed (meaning decision m3), so every level keeps "limpio"; Readable adds "sanar" as the English adds "heal".

decisions.choice: purifier (L); rendre pur (B, R)
decisions.reason: The man asks to be healed and made clean before the law (meaning decision m3). "Pur" keeps the sense of ritual cleanness; Readable adds "guérir", as the English Readable adds "heal". The same words follow in 1:41-44.

source.text: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἥψατο καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Θέλω, καθαρίσθητι·

records.literal_gloss: And having become angry, having stretched out the hand of him he touched and says to him, I am willing, be cleansed.

en.L: And becoming angry, stretching out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} touched [him] and says to him, "I am willing; be cleansed."
en.B: Stirred with anger, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand and touched him. "I am willing," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told him. "Be made clean!"
en.R: Jesus was angry. He put out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand and touched the man. He said, "I do want to. Be healed and clean!"

vi.L: Và nổi giận, giơ tay ra, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào [người ấy] và nói với người ấy: "Ta muốn; hãy được sạch."
vi.B: Ngài nổi giận, đưa tay ra chạm vào người ấy và bảo: "Ta muốn. Hãy được sạch!"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nổi giận. Ngài đưa tay ra chạm vào người ấy và nói: "Ta muốn chứ! Hãy được lành và được sạch!"

ko.L: 그러자 그분은 화를 내시며 손을 내밀어 [그를] 만지시고 그에게 말씀하신다. "내가 원한다. 깨끗하게 되어라."
ko.B: 예수께서는 마음속에 분노가 일어, 손을 내밀어 그를 만지시며 말씀하셨다. "내가 원한다. 깨끗해져라!"
ko.R: 예수께서는 화가 나셨다. 예수께서 손을 내밀어 그 사람을 만지시며 말씀하셨다. "그래, 내가 원한다. 병이 나아 깨끗해져라!"

es.L: Y enojándose, extendiendo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano, [lo] tocó, y le dice: «Quiero; queda limpio».
es.B: Movido por la ira, extendió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano y lo tocó. «Quiero —le dijo—. ¡Queda limpio!».
es.R: Jesús se enojó. Extendió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano y tocó al hombre. Le dijo: «Sí quiero. ¡Queda sano y limpio!».

fr.L: Et s’étant mis en colère, ayant étendu {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [le] toucha et lui dit : « Je [le] veux, sois purifié. »
fr.B: Saisi de colère, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} étendit la main et le toucha. « Je le veux, lui dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}. Sois purifié ! »
fr.R: Jésus s’est mis en colère. Il a tendu la main et a touché l’homme. Il lui a dit : « Oui, je le veux. Sois guéri et pur ! »

decisions.choice: becoming angry, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts read "moved with compassion". A few, including Codex Bezae and some Old Latin copies, read "becoming angry", which the SBLGNT prints. Scribes were more likely to soften anger into compassion than the reverse, and Mark speaks of Jesus' anger elsewhere (3:5; 10:14). Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: angry: Mark does not say at what
alternatives: angry at the disease and the evil behind it
decisions.reason: Jesus' anger may be at the disease and its power over the man, or at a world that shut him out. Nothing in the story says he is angry with the man, whom he heals at once.

decisions.choice: he touched him: he touched a man the law called unclean
decisions.reason: Touching an unclean person made one unclean (Leviticus 5:3). Here cleanness passes from Jesus to the man instead.

decisions.choice: I am willing: the answer to "if you are willing"
decisions.reason: Jesus takes up the man's own word (1:40).

decisions.choice: touched him (B); touched the man (R)
decisions.reason: Greek can leave out the object; English needs it.

decisions.choice: [le] toucha; Je [le] veux
decisions.reason: French "toucher" and "vouloir" here need an object pronoun the Greek does not have; Literal brackets it.

source.text: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα, καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθη.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately went away from him the leprosy, and he was cleansed.

en.L: And immediately the leprosy went away from him, and he was made clean.
en.B: In that moment the disease was gone from him, and he was clean.
en.R: Right away the skin disease went away, and the man was healed and clean.

vi.L: Và lập tức bệnh phung rời khỏi người ấy, và người ấy được sạch.
vi.B: Ngay lúc đó, bệnh ấy biến mất khỏi người ấy, và anh được sạch.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức, bệnh ngoài da ấy biến mất. Người ấy được lành và được sạch.

ko.L: 그러자 곧 나병이 그에게서 떠나가고, 그는 깨끗하게 되었다.
ko.B: 그 순간 그 병이 그에게서 사라지고, 그는 깨끗해졌다.
ko.R: 바로 그 피부병이 없어지고, 그 사람은 병이 나아 깨끗해졌다.

es.L: Y enseguida la lepra se fue de él, y quedó limpio.
es.B: En ese mismo instante la enfermedad lo dejó, y quedó limpio.
es.R: Enseguida la enfermedad de la piel desapareció, y el hombre quedó sano y limpio.

fr.L: Et aussitôt la lèpre s’en alla de lui, et il fut purifié.
fr.B: À l’instant même, la maladie le quitta, et il fut pur.
fr.R: Tout de suite, la maladie de peau est partie, et l’homme a été guéri et rendu pur.

decisions.choice: he was cleansed: made clean by God's act through Jesus' word
decisions.reason: The passive verb answers Jesus' command "be cleansed" (1:41).

decisions.choice: immediately: the cure was instant and complete
decisions.reason: The disease left at once, before the priest could examine him.

source.text: καὶ ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν, καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Ὅρα μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε περὶ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ σου ἃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And having sternly charged him immediately he sent away him, \v 44 and says to him, See nothing to no one you say, but go yourself show to the priest and offer for the cleansing of you what commanded Moses, for a testimony to them.

en.L: And sternly warning him, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} immediately sent him away \v 44 and says to him, "See [that] you say nothing to anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
en.B: Jesus gave him a stern warning and sent him away at once. \v 44 "Be sure you tell no one about this," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said. "Instead, go and let the priest examine you. Then offer what Moses required for your cleansing. That will be evidence to them."
en.R: Jesus quickly sent him away with a strong warning. \v 44 He said, "Do not tell anyone about this. Go and show yourself to the priest. Then give the offering that Moses commanded for people who are made clean. That will prove to them that you are clean."

vi.L: Và nghiêm khắc căn dặn người ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lập tức bảo người ấy đi, \v 44 và nói với người ấy: "Hãy coi chừng, đừng nói gì với ai cả, nhưng hãy đi trình diện thầy tế lễ và dâng cho sự tẩy sạch của anh những gì Môi-se đã truyền, để làm chứng cho họ."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nghiêm khắc cảnh cáo anh và lập tức cho anh đi. \v 44 Ngài bảo: "Hãy cẩn thận, đừng nói với ai điều gì cả. Nhưng hãy đi trình diện thầy tế lễ để ông ấy khám cho anh, rồi dâng những gì Môi-se đã truyền về việc anh được sạch. Đó sẽ là bằng chứng cho họ."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cảnh cáo anh rất nghiêm khắc và bảo anh đi ngay. \v 44 Ngài nói: "Đừng kể cho ai biết việc này. Hãy đi trình diện thầy tế lễ. Rồi hãy dâng của lễ mà Môi-se đã truyền cho những người được sạch. Việc đó sẽ chứng tỏ cho họ biết anh đã được sạch."

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 그에게 엄하게 경고하시고 곧 그를 내보내셨다. \v 44 그리고 그에게 말씀하신다. "아무에게도 아무 말도 하지 않도록 주의하여라. 다만 가서 제사장에게 네 자신을 보여라. 그리고 네가 깨끗하게 된 것에 대하여 모세가 명령한 것을 바쳐서, 그들에게 증거가 되게 하여라."
ko.B: 예수께서는 그에게 엄하게 경고하시고 곧바로 그를 보내셨다. \v 44 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "아무에게도 이 일을 말하지 않도록 조심하여라. 그 대신 가서 제사장에게 네 몸을 보여 검사를 받아라. 그리고 모세가 정한 대로 네가 깨끗해진 것에 대한 예물을 바쳐라. 그것이 그들에게 증거가 될 것이다."
ko.R: 예수께서는 그 사람에게 단단히 주의를 주시고 곧 돌려보내셨다. \v 44 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "이 일을 아무에게도 말하지 마라. 가서 제사장에게 네 몸을 보여라. 그리고 병이 나아 깨끗해진 사람이 바치도록 모세가 명령한 예물을 바쳐라. 그러면 네가 깨끗해졌다는 것이 그들에게 증명될 것이다."

es.L: Y advirtiéndole severamente, enseguida lo despidió, \v 44 y le dice: «Mira, no digas nada a nadie, sino ve, muéstrate al sacerdote y ofrece por tu purificación lo que Moisés ordenó, para testimonio a ellos».
es.B: Jesús le hizo una advertencia severa y lo despidió enseguida. \v 44 «Ten cuidado de no contarle esto a nadie —le dijo—. Más bien, ve a que el sacerdote te examine, y luego presenta por tu purificación la ofrenda que Moisés mandó. Eso les servirá de prueba».
es.R: Jesús lo despidió enseguida con una advertencia muy seria. \v 44 Le dijo: «No le cuentes esto a nadie. Ve y preséntate ante el sacerdote. Después da la ofrenda que Moisés ordenó para los que quedan limpios. Así les demostrarás que estás limpio».

fr.L: Et l’ayant averti sévèrement, aussitôt {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le renvoya, \v 44 et lui dit : « Veille à ne rien dire à personne, mais va, montre-toi au prêtre et offre pour ta purification ce que Moïse a prescrit, en témoignage pour eux. »
fr.B: Jésus lui fit une sévère mise en garde et le renvoya aussitôt. \v 44 « Surtout, ne dis rien à personne, lui dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}. Mais va te faire examiner par le prêtre, puis offre pour ta purification ce que Moïse a prescrit. Cela leur servira de preuve. »
fr.R: Jésus l’a vite renvoyé, en l’avertissant avec force. \v 44 Il lui a dit : « Ne raconte cela à personne. Va te montrer au prêtre. Ensuite, fais l’offrande que Moïse a commandée pour ceux qui sont rendus purs. Cela leur prouvera que tu es pur. »

decisions.choice: sternly warning: speaking with deep feeling and force
decisions.reason: The word describes strong emotion, at times a snort of anger (14:5). Here it gives force to the warning that follows.

decisions.choice: sent him away: sent him out at once
decisions.reason: This is the verb of 1:12 and 1:34. It shows urgency, not anger at the man.

decisions.choice: show yourself to the priest: the law of Leviticus 14
decisions.reason: A priest examined a person healed of a skin disease and declared him clean. Then the person offered the sacrifices the law of Moses set out, and could return to the community.

decisions.choice: as a testimony to them: proof to the priests and people that he is clean
decisions.reason: "To them" most likely means the priests and the people. The words can also carry a warning, as in 6:11 and 13:9.

decisions.choice: tell no one: Jesus does not want to be known as a healer only
alternatives: a test of the man's obedience
decisions.reason: Jesus keeps his work quiet, as with the demons (1:34), and the man's report soon stops him entering towns (1:45).

decisions.choice: evidence (B); prove to them that you are clean (R)
decisions.reason: "Testimony" sounds like a speech in English; the word here means proof.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἐξελθὼν ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν πολλὰ καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον, ὥστε μηκέτι αὐτὸν δύνασθαι φανερῶς εἰς πόλιν εἰσελθεῖν, ἀλλὰ ἔξω ἐπ’ ἐρήμοις τόποις ἦν· καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν.

records.literal_gloss: But he having gone out began to proclaim much and to spread abroad the word, so that no longer him to be able openly into city to enter, but outside in solitary places he was; and they were coming to him from everywhere.

en.L: But he went out and began to proclaim [it] freely and to spread the word abroad, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was no longer able to enter a town openly, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was outside in deserted places; and they kept coming to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from everywhere.
en.B: But the man went off and began telling everyone, spreading the news of what had happened, so much that Jesus could not go into any town openly anymore. He kept to deserted places out in the country, and still people came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from every direction.
en.R: But the man went away and told many people what had happened. He spread the news everywhere. Because of this, Jesus could not go into a town where people could see {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stayed out in lonely places. But people still came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from everywhere.

vi.L: Nhưng người ấy ra đi, bắt đầu rao truyền nhiều và loan truyền lời ấy ra khắp nơi, đến nỗi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không còn có thể công khai vào thành, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở bên ngoài, tại những nơi hoang vắng; và người ta từ khắp nơi kéo đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nhưng người ấy đi ra và bắt đầu kể cho mọi người, loan tin về việc đã xảy ra, đến nỗi Đức Giê-xu không thể công khai vào thành nào nữa. Ngài ở bên ngoài, tại những nơi hoang vắng, nhưng người ta vẫn từ khắp nơi kéo đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng người ấy đi và kể cho nhiều người biết việc đã xảy ra. Anh loan tin ấy khắp nơi. Vì vậy, Đức Giê-xu không thể vào thị trấn nào mà không bị người ta thấy. Ngài phải ở ngoài những nơi vắng vẻ. Nhưng người ta vẫn từ khắp nơi đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 그는 나가서 [그 일을] 많이 선포하고 그 말을 널리 퍼뜨리기 시작했다. 그 결과 그분은 더 이상 드러내 놓고 고을에 들어가실 수 없어서, 바깥 외딴곳들에 계셨다. 그리고 사람들이 사방에서 그분께로 오고 있었다.
ko.B: 그러나 그 사람은 나가서 이 일을 여기저기 이야기하며 소문을 퍼뜨리기 시작했다. 그 때문에 예수께서는 더 이상 드러내 놓고 어느 동네에도 들어가실 수 없어서, 바깥 외딴곳에서 지내셨다. 그래도 사람들은 사방에서 예수께 모여들었다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 사람은 나가서 많은 사람에게 이 일을 이야기했다. 그는 이 소식을 곳곳에 퍼뜨렸다. 그래서 예수께서는 사람들 눈에 띄게 마을에 들어가실 수 없었다. 그래서 사람들이 없는 조용한 곳에 계셨다. 그래도 사람들은 사방에서 예수께 찾아왔다.

es.L: Pero él, saliendo, comenzó a proclamar mucho y a divulgar la palabra, de modo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya no podía entrar abiertamente en una ciudad, sino que estaba fuera, en lugares desiertos; y venían a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} de todas partes.
es.B: Pero el hombre se fue y comenzó a contarlo a todo el mundo, difundiendo la noticia de lo que había pasado, tanto que Jesús ya no podía entrar abiertamente en ningún pueblo. Se quedaba fuera, en lugares despoblados, y aun así la gente acudía a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} de todas partes.
es.R: Pero el hombre se fue y le contó a mucha gente lo que había pasado. Difundió la noticia por todas partes. Por eso, Jesús ya no podía entrar en un pueblo sin que la gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} viera. Así que se quedaba en lugares solitarios. Pero aun así, la gente venía a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} de todas partes.

fr.L: Mais lui, étant sorti, commença à [le] proclamer abondamment et à répandre la nouvelle, de sorte que {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne pouvait plus entrer ouvertement dans une ville, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se tenait dehors, dans des lieux déserts ; et ils venaient à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} de partout.
fr.B: Mais l’homme, une fois parti, se mit à tout raconter et à répandre partout la nouvelle, si bien que Jésus ne pouvait plus entrer ouvertement dans une ville. Il restait dehors, dans des lieux déserts, et l’on venait quand même à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} de toutes parts.
fr.R: Mais l’homme est parti et il a raconté à beaucoup de gens ce qui s’était passé. Il a répandu la nouvelle partout. À cause de cela, Jésus ne pouvait plus entrer dans une ville sans que les gens {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voient. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} restait dans des endroits isolés. Mais les gens venaient quand même vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} de partout.

decisions.choice: he went out: the man who was healed
decisions.reason: The subject changes to Jesus only in the next clause, "so that he was no longer able". Some read Jesus as the one proclaiming throughout, but the man's disobedience fits 1:44.

decisions.choice: the word: the matter, what had happened
decisions.reason: The word can mean the message (2:2), and Mark may play on it, since the man "proclaims" as John and Jesus do. Here it is the news of his healing.

decisions.choice: so that: the result of the man's talking
alternatives: the reason Jesus avoided towns from the start
decisions.reason: Because of the crowds, Jesus could no longer come into a town openly.

decisions.choice: deserted places: the word for wilderness again
decisions.reason: As in 1:35, Jesus is out where no one lives, and yet people come to him there, as they came to John (1:5).

decisions.choice: the man; Jesus
decisions.reason: Greek moves from one "he" to another. Balanced and Readable name each one.

decisions.choice: "선포하고" (L) for what the healed man did
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "선포하다", the word used for John's and Jesus' proclaiming (1:4, 1:14, 1:38-39), so the reader can see that Mark uses the same verb for the man; Balanced and Readable say what he did, talking about it everywhere.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya no podía
decisions.reason: Spanish usually leaves the subject in the verb, but here the subject changes from the healed man to Jesus, so Literal writes the pronoun, with the setting, where the Greek has one for the infinitive.

decisions.choice: la nouvelle (L, B)
decisions.reason: Here the Greek word means the matter, what had happened (meaning decision m2). "Répandre la parole" would suggest God's word; "répandre la nouvelle" is the French idiom for spreading news.
